audit_scope.description: This audit covers both EL (EVM precompiles, opcodes) and CL (fork choice, data availability, proposer selection) logic and their interfaces.

out_of_scope_reasons.Mainnet/Testnet Testing: All testing should be done on local forks of testnet or mainnet
out_of_scope_reasons.Pricing Oracles: Incorrect data supplied by third party oracles (oracle manipulation/flash loan attacks are in-scope)
out_of_scope_reasons.Third-party Smart Contracts: Any testing with third-party systems and applications is prohibited
out_of_scope_reasons.Test Files: Impacts on test files and configuration files unless stated otherwise
out_of_scope_reasons.Configuration Files: Impacts on test files and configuration files unless stated otherwise
out_of_scope_reasons.Centralization Risks: Impacts involving centralization risks are out-of-scope
out_of_scope_reasons.Privileged Access: Impacts caused by attacks requiring access to privileged addresses without additional modifications are out-of-scope

misclassified_entities.reason: WebAuthn/FIDO2 device is the ultimate origin of signature data but does not directly interact with the EVM precompile. The actual caller is a smart contract relaying the signature. This entity represents an upstream data source, not a direct system interactor. Retained for completeness but the trust boundary is at the contract call, not the device.

trusted_external_entities.name: Smart Contract via EVM CALL
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Any smart contract can invoke the precompile with arbitrary calldata. Input is fully untrusted and must be validated (length, bounds, curve membership, identity check).

trusted_external_entities.name: Network Peer via P2P Gossip
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peer nodes gossip signed beacon blocks over unauthenticated P2P network. Blocks may be malformed, invalid, or from malicious peers. Full validation pipeline required.

trusted_external_entities.name: P2P Network Peers via Column Sidecar Requests
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Column sidecars are retrieved from peers over unauthenticated P2P. Peers may provide malformed sidecars, invalid KZG proofs, or withhold data. Format and KZG proof verification required.

trusted_external_entities.name: Beacon Network (RANDAO Reveals)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: RANDAO values are revealed publicly in block proposals. Validators may attempt to manipulate proposer selection by observing RANDAO and grinding effective balances. The lookahead mechanism mitigates this.

trusted_external_entities.name: Malicious Validator via Beacon P2P
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Validators may attempt effective balance grinding, propose invalid blocks, submit conflicting attestations, or attempt censorship. All validator actions must be validated against protocol rules.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter via JSON-RPC / P2P
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: eth_sendRawTransaction RPC or P2P transaction gossip
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Archetypal top-down threat: users or DApps submit transactions that may invoke new opcodes (CLZ) or precompiles (secp256r1) with crafted inputs. Fully untrusted.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Input must be validated: exactly 160 bytes, signature bounds (0 < r,s < n), public key field bounds (0 <= qx,qy < p), curve equation membership (qy^2 = qx^3 + ax + b mod p), and non-identity check ((qx,qy) != (0,0)). Gas must be consumed regardless of validation outcome.
Full validation pipeline required: parent known, slot not in future, after finalized slot, finalized ancestry, data availability (column sidecars with KZG proofs), and state transition execution.

Each column sidecar must pass format verification (verify_data_column_sidecar) and KZG proof verification (verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs). Unavailable sidecars must cause data availability failure, not silent acceptance.

RANDAO-based proposer selection must use effective balances frozen at epoch N - MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD - 1, preventing post-RANDAO balance grinding. Lookahead must be computed deterministically from consensus state.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Beacon P2P (block proposals, attestations, effective balance changes)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Effective balance changes after RANDAO reveal must not affect already-computed proposer schedule. Proposer lookahead must be immutable once computed. Standard slashing conditions apply for conflicting attestations.
CLZ opcode must consume fixed 5 gas. Stack underflow must revert. Input of 0 must return 256. Opcode must be invalid before fork activation. Gas cost must be sufficient to prevent DoS.
